raw.title: Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics
raw.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

Who you are

We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.

Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.

What you’ll do

  • Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

  • Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.

  • Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.

  • Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.

  • Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.

  • Shape pricing and commercial decisions: Translate underlying payment economics into recommendations for customer pricing, product design, new market launches and commercial strategy, ensuring growth is supported by sustainable unit economics.

  • Build scalable infrastructure and automation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to strengthen cost engines, fee allocation logic, dashboards and automated controls. Apply AI and advanced analytics to accelerate rule interpretation, detect anomalies and surface optimization opportunities.

  • Own complex scheme economics issues: Serve as the escalation point for scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions, working directly with Visa, Mastercard and other payment partners where required.

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or related roles, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

  • Deep knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules.

  • Strong ability to operationalize complex payment rules, translating fee schedules and network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.

  • Experience with payment cost systems and controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modeling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to connect detailed payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimization.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale.

  • Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

raw.description:
Senior Software Engineer (Motorsport)

DO YOU WANT TO WORK FOR THE WORLD LEADER IN ELITE SPORTS PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS?

Catapult is a world leader in sports performance technology, serving over 5000 teams across 40 sports. We improve many of your favorite athletes' performances with our wearable tracking technology, video and data analysis systems, and athlete management products. Our technology offers objective solutions to sport-based challenges and can be found throughout the NFL, NHL, NBA, AFL, NRL, Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga and many more.

In Motorsport, Catapult's SBG race management and team strategy systems are the technology of choice for elite-level organisers and competitors around the world, including in Formula 1, Formula E, IndyCar, NASCAR, WEC/Le Mans and other worldwide endurance racing. Customers include the FIA (in F1, F2, F3, F1 Academy, FE and WEC), nine Formula 1 teams (including the 8-time World Champion Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team), the majority of Formula E teams, the winners of multiple Le Mans 24-hour races over the last 10 years (Audi, Porsche, and Toyota) and teams and organisers in both IndyCar and NASCAR. 

We have major offices in the UK (London and Leeds), USA (Boston) and Australia (Melbourne) as well as multiple smaller offices around the world.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SPORTS AND WANT TO WIN

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Senior Software Engineer (Motorsport) to grow our Motorsport development team as we expand our RaceWatch products into new series and tackle new challenges.

Based in London, you will be a key player in developing new capabilities in RaceWatch, particularly for Endurance racing strategy, but also contributing to the entire RaceWatch suite across different racing series.

We believe that our customers deserve the best platform, and we are on a mission to maximise and enhance their performance through delivering the highest quality experience. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help us drive our products and processes forward, as well as acting as a mentor and providing technical leadership to other team members. You will be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series.
  • Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks.
  • Identify ways to add innovative new features to the software.
  • Lead others to anticipate and meet customer needs.
  • Be one of the technical leaders within the team.
  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
  • Ensure code quality, organization, and best practices throughout the development process.
  • Lead with a growth mindset, encouraging others to share ideas and opinions.
  • Maintain and enhance software reliability.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • A passion for Motorsport.
  • 5+ years working in a fast-paced, technical environment, delivering software to customers.
  • A proven track record of building applications in C/C++.
  • Experience developing products, scaling them, and supporting them throughout the entire lifecycle.
  • An aptitude for working with complex data.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, both internally and when speaking to customers.
  • A willingness to go above and beyond for the customer.
  • Ability to help cover live motorsport events at weekends on a rotational basis with the rest of the team.
  • An ability to multi-task and thrive in a dynamic work environment with changing priorities.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Degree in computer science or other scientific or technical subject.
  • Prior experience working in motorsport is a strong advantage.
  • An understanding of the challenges faced by motorsport officials and teams in managing and participating in events.
  • Experience using Catapult's RaceWatch software.
  • Experience with ticketing and project management platforms, such as JIRA or Monday.
  • Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio.
  • Experience developing applications that process video.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication; to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries so you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures.
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.
  • We care about you. We offer outstanding paid maternity and paternity leave.

Whether you are interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams, organisations and competitors on the planet! While we have access to many exciting opportunities, we also realize that we are here to do a very important job for our customers. As a result, we aim to work with purpose and intention. We look for people that fit into our team culture, those who actively contribute and individuals who are excited about what they do. 

In order to build the future of sports performance, we need the brightest talent. If you think you can contribute to the empowering, enjoyable and exciting Catapult environment, then we invite you to apply.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

We’re looking for an Embedded Software Engineer who thrives close to the hardware and enjoys building high-performance, reliable firmware for DSP architecture and microcontrollers (e.g., RISC V and Arm Cortex M/A). You’ll design and implement real-time embedded software, optimize compute-heavy pipelines, and collaborate with hardware and systems teams to bring products from concept to production.
 
This role suits someone who can move comfortably between architecture/design, low-level firmware, and performance tuning—especially where latency, throughput, power, and determinism matter.

  • Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware for DSP cores and MCUs (RISC V and/or Arm).

  • Work with SoC/board peripherals: DMA, timers, SPI, I²C, UART, I²S/TDM, PWM, GPIO, and relevant bus fabrics.
  • Bring up new hardware: boot flows, clocks, memory maps, interrupt vectors, peripheral init, and early validation.
  • Implement and debug drivers and RTOS components (e.g., Zephyr or equivalent), including task scheduling, synchronization primitives, and ISR design.
  • Develop test strategies: unit tests, hardware-in-the-loop tests, test automation, and manufacturing/production diagnostics.
  • Use debugging/profiling tools: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, trace (ETM/ITM), and cycle-accurate profiling when available.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware, FPGA/ASIC, systems, and application teams to define requirements and interfaces.
  • Contribute documentation: architecture notes, interface specs, timing budgets, work packages, and bring-up guides.
  • Participate in code reviews and help establish best practices for embedded quality, safety, and maintainability.

  • register-level programming, memory-mapped I/O
  • concurrency (ISRs, RTOS tasks), race conditions, timing determinism
  • fixed-point arithmetic, numerical precision, and overflow/underflow management
  • Proven ability to optimize firmware: cycle counting, memory layout, DMA usage, cache behavior, minimizing latency and jitter.
  • Comfortable with toolchains and build systems:
  • GCC/LLVM-based toolchains, cross-compilation
  • CMake/Make, Meson, linker scripts, map files
  • Strong debugging skills with hardware and firmware:
  • JTAG/SWD debugging
  • root-cause analysis of timing and performance issues
  • Source control expertise (Git) and disciplined engineering practices (code reviews, CI).

raw.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

About WPP Production

WPP Production is the world's leading creative content production company. Born to make the best work brilliantly, we combine craft, insight and technology to bring creative work to life for many of the world's most famous brands.

Department Summary

The Growth Team is responsible for driving incremental revenue for WPP Production. Focussed primarily on New Business, the team is one of the few that works closely with all departments across the business to deliver best in class responses to client requests for proposals. Often the first touch-point a new client has with the company, the team plays a critical role in presenting WPP Production in the best possible light whilst living and breathing the company values. 

Senior Growth Manager

The role 
The Senior Growth Manager plays a central role in driving WPP Production's growth, leading pitch responses, RFP's submissions and client presentations that clearly articulate our value and deliver winning results.

This role blends strategic thinking with strong project leadership. You'll take ownership of multiple opportunities — managing timelines, inputs, and stakeholders to ensure every response is delivered on time and to the highest standard — while also shaping the story that ties it all together.

You'll be responsible for creating a clear red thread and a compelling narrative that connects disparate materials into a cohesive, client-centric story. Working alongside client leads, you'll ensure every submission has a strong overarching narrative — one that is distinct, persuasive, and directly addresses the client's brief and objectives.

You'll help define the strategic approach for each opportunity, ensuring the story, structure, and positioning of every response reflect WPP Production's proposition and competitive advantage. You'll balance creative flair with commercial understanding — able to explain how our operational model works, why it's effective, and what it delivers for clients.

Key activities:  

  • Take ownership of specific new business opportunities, leading the process end-to-end — from strategy to submission.
  • Develop cohesive and compelling narratives that bring together strategy, operations, and creative thinking into a unified client story.
  • Shape and articulate operational models and value propositions clearly — demonstrating how they work, why they matter, and the benefit to the client.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and client leads to ensure each response and presentation has a strong, client-centric narrative.
  • Liaise with WPP agencies and colleagues on multi-agency opportunities.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders in WPP Production, WPP, WPP OpCos, and intermediaries.
  • Support the ongoing development of case studies, marketing collateral, and credentials materials.
  • Ensure the New Business Growth Hub is up to date with high-quality content that adheres to brand guidelines.
  • Monitor and evaluate competitor activity and broader industry trends to keep WPP Production's positioning sharp and differentiated.

Requirements 

  • Advertising experience/Production background is preferable
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to connect complex ideas into clear, persuasive narratives.
  • Strategic thinker who can distil complexity into clarity and align ideas to client needs and business outcomes.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills and confidence engaging with senior stakeholders across WPP Production, WPP, and client organisations.
  • Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple projects and large volumes of content across stakeholders.

Diversity and Inclusion 

WPP Production is committed to diversity and inclusion, through our ideas, our people, how we behave and conduct ourselves. Creating a truly inclusive culture at all levels of the organisation that encourages different points of view, making WPP Production not only a better company and place to work but an environment where everyone experiences connection, opportunity and a sense of belonging.

#Hybrid

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does an UK- New Business Director do at WPP Production? 
  

The role

The New Business Director plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production, defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities and shaping the strategic direction of our UK growth function.

You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority new business opportunities, designing integrated solutions and clear go-to-market propositions.  You will ensure that every response (whether formal RFP or informal approach) is clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across all UK pitches, setting the standard for how we articulate our value.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in driving integration across Media, Creative and Production, shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions.

Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth — defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally. This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team.

This is a high-impact role with visibility across the whole UK business, suited to someone who thrives in the fast-paced world of new business, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth and business impact at scale.

 

Key areas of responsibility:

  • Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning
  • Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across all pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value
  • Design end-to-end client solutions and commercial models, including operating models, pricing approach and value proposition
  • Lead the development of go-to-market propositions, continuously evolving how WPP Production positions itself in market
  • Work with the Global Chief Growth Officer to define and drive the global growth strategy for WPP Production, identifying priority markets, opportunity types and areas of focus
  • Define and influence where we focus our growth efforts, ensuring time and resource are prioritised on the highest value opportunities
  • Analyse pipeline, performance and market trends to identify where growth is coming from — and where it should come from next
  • Partner with senior leadership to shape growth priorities, targets and investment decisions
  • Drive improved conversion, efficiency and revenue impact across the new business pipeline through stronger strategic positioning and approach
  • Build and scale a repeatable growth engine, embedding frameworks, playbooks, tools and best practice that enable teams globally to win consistently without central dependency
  • Act as a "pitch doctor", stepping into critical opportunities to strengthen narrative, structure and overall response quality
  • Present and represent WPP Production in senior client meetings & pitch meetings
  • Drive cross-WPP integration, ensuring seamless collaboration across Media, Creative and Production
  • Identify and embed new ways of working, improving how we approach, structure and deliver pitches
  • Lead on innovation in growth, including exploring the use of AI and new technologies to enhance team capability and efficiency
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP and key client organisations
  • Develop and scale team capability, through coaching, mentoring and training

 What good looks like:

  • Significant experience in new business, client leadership, growth or strategy roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, with a proven ability to define how complex opportunities are approached and won
  • Outstanding writing and storytelling ability, with experience leading narrative development for high-value, multi-disciplinary pitches
  • Strong commercial acumen, with experience designing and influencing commercial models, pricing strategies and value propositions
  • Able to use and apply AI tools to the new business process
  • Proven experience leading large, complex and high-value pitch processes, often involving multiple stakeholders and disciplines

Technical Adoption Architects (TAA) are product experts and problem solvers. They are responsible for understanding our customers’ goals, validating how Ironclad can meet their critical requirements, and advising on AI-supported contracting processes to help customers realize value quickly and progress through their implementation and adoption journey. Technical Adoption Architects are core to our Customer Value team and work cross-functionally to deliver a best-in-class experience for our customers from early proof of value through activation and adoption.

We are currently only considering candidates based out of London. As this is a hybrid role, office attendance is required at least twice a week for collaboration and connection. There may be additional in-office days for team or company events.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Partner with Account teams and Adoption Strategists to drive customer adoption from pre-sales requirements gathering and early proof-of-value motions through strategic roadmapping, phased implementation, and successful activation. Validate product and solution fit, customer risks, and success measures, and translate those inputs into a practical path to value.

  • Design and build customers' contracting processes in Ironclad translating solution design into configured workflows, templates, and integrations that set them up to own and expand the platform over time. Apply strong platform architecture and technical solution-design judgment, including recommendations about integrations, sequencing, maintainability, and long-term extensibility.

  • Own high-value customer use cases end-to-end, determining the right technical solution approach and phased scope based on customer goals, critical requirements, and what matters most to both the buy decision and downstream adoption success.

  • Act as a trusted thought partner and advisor to customers - building relationships, navigating complex problem-solving, resetting expectations in challenging conversations, and identifying high-value opportunities to scale their use of Ironclad. Build alignment across Legal, Sales, Procurement, IT, executive sponsors, and other stakeholder groups; identify adoption risks; and help customers navigate organizational change.

  • Serve as the voice of the customer inside Ironclad, feeding insights from customer engagements and direct product expertise regularly to our Product team.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally - with Account Team, Adoption Strategists, Enterprise Architects, Forward Deployed Engineering, Legal AI Specialists, Support, and Success - to guide customers across the full journey and support their success.

What We're Looking For:

Required:

  • 4+ years of professional services and/or consulting experience with software companies.

  • Passion for learning new technologies and driving outcomes through technical solutions.

  • You connect technical decisions to customer value, adoption outcomes, and long-term platform ownership.

This involves deeply understanding the dynamics and priorities of customers’ Legal, Sales, Procurement, IT, and other stakeholder groups. You can identify decision-makers, executive sponsors, influencers, and blockers and build alignment across them.

  • A transformation mindset. You are motivated by progressing a customer through adoption journey milestones and business outcomes.
